draft_reason: document themes were reconstructed from scattered Markdown and evidence surfaces during topology cleanup.
promotion_condition: all sensitive Markdown and evidence capsule paths are classified, canonical targets exist, and theme topology validation remains green after Git membrane closure.
purpose: Machine-readable classification of sensitive scattered docs by organism theme. This is an inventory, not a policy source.

archive.exit_condition: remove the archive entry when the file is deleted or promote it to evidence if it becomes durable source material
archive.rule: Archived documents are retained only as historical evidence and must point to the current canonical target that supersedes them.

delete_candidate.exit_condition: delete the file, archive it as historical evidence, or promote it to a governed status with a canonical target
delete_candidate.rule: Delete candidates are explicitly non-canonical and must not be used as policy, runtime instructions, or source-of-truth material.

draft.exit_condition: promote to canonical/projection/evidence, archive, or delete once the canonical target has absorbed the durable content
draft.rule: Draft documents may exist only as working material mapped to a canonical target; they do not outrank axioms, registry, AGENTS.md, or foundation policy.
